question: The value of [(102 – 16 ÷ 8) – 2] ÷ [3 + 6 × (5 + 4) ÷ 3 – 7] is:
solution:
Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cc8f63640c17e5af9cdfc3b1e0aec219549b666eec21d379b8feb7bd6c52eb4.png] 

Calculation:

[(102 – 16 ÷ 8) – 2] ÷ [3 + 6 × (5 + 4) ÷ 3 – 7]

⇒ [(102 – 2) – 2] ÷ [3 + 6 × 9 ÷ 3 – 7] 

⇒ [100 – 2] ÷ [3 + 6 × 3 – 7] 

⇒ 98 ÷ [3 + 18 – 7] 

⇒ 98 ÷ 14

⇒ 7

∴ The required answer is 7.
